item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The excerpt presents the crowd-attack claim as a police official's account and the detention/injury claims as organizers' accounts."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":["The allegations about Rwanda and Charter violations are presented as Tshisekedi's message, not independently verified findings."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Ahead of the December 2023 elections, the Brookings description cited concerns about corruption, election irregularities, fraud, the absence of a credible challenger, violence in eastern DRC, mining-sector human-rights abuses, the departure of two peacekeeping forces, the EU's withdrawal of its election-observation mission, and mistrust of CENI's independence.","notes":["The excerpt does not attribute every listed condition to observers' concerns; several are described as the election's broader backdrop."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In September 2023, the Presidency held, under Tshisekedi's patronage, a workshop on strengthening values and anti-corruption measures within the Presidency; participants discussed integrity, ethics, accountability, transparency, the rule of law, and results-oriented governance, and the cabinet director said recommendations would be followed up.","notes":["The excerpt supports presidential patronage, not the stronger wording that the Presidency sponsored the workshop."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E009","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 27 December 2023, authorities prohibited an opposition march in Kinshasa contesting the 20 December election; police deployed roughly one hundred officers, police vehicles, and armored vehicles around the planned route and prevented gatherings. Opponents alleged massive fraud and sought annulment of the vote, whose partial results showed Tshisekedi leading.","notes":["The excerpt refers to opponents, not specifically opposition candidates."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E010","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"An OHCHR communications search listed a 15 May 2023 communication concerning the alleged assassination of human-rights defender Obedi Karafuru, under mandates covering human-rights defenders, environment, executions, and freedom of peaceful assembly and association.","notes":["The 7 November 2023 date in the excerpt belongs to a different communication concerning Zawadi Maulizo and Shakurani Ethiene."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E013","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In his 20 September 2023 UN General Assembly speech, Tshisekedi said discussions were underway for an accelerated, progressive MONUSCO withdrawal beginning in December 2023, criticized peacekeeping missions deployed in the DRC over the preceding 25 years for failing to address conflicts and protect civilians, and requested sanctions against perpetrators of serious crimes in the DRC.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the failure claim to peacekeeping missions generally, not exclusively to MONUSCO."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0021-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
